lines.text: Shopify rewrote its whole mobile app in twelve weeks, and AI agents wrote most of the code.
They moved from one shared React Native codebase to two native apps, Swift and Kotlin.
lines.title: The move

lines.text: First a small group built the rails: one shared design, fast tests, and checks that fail when code drifts.
lines.title: Build the rails first

lines.text: The old app was the spec. Agents took small steps and checked each one against it.
lines.title: Small steps

lines.text: Once code was quick, the slow parts moved. Agents review first, and humans decide last.
lines.title: New bottlenecks

lines.text: Android launch time dropped about half, and crash-free sessions rose to nearly all.
lines.title: Android results

lines.text: The lesson: with fast AI code, the real work is the system around it.
lines.title: Takeaways
